_comment: Canonical inventory counts for Athena-Public. Single source of truth for README claims, docs, and audit asserts. If a number in any doc diverges from this file, CAPS wins. Regenerate via the recount_rules below — do not edit counts by hand. Headline claims in README use verifiable FLOORS (e.g. '200+ protocols'), not exact numbers that drift.

protocols.recount_note: Public corpus is a curated subset (~45%) of the private instance. Curation is intentional: top-value protocols ship, personal ones do not.

skills.recount_note: All public skills carry context_trigger frontmatter. auto-invoke:true is agent-discretion unless backed by a hook (see examples/hooks/README.md).

sessions.recount_note: Private-instance session count backing the public claims; verify against the portfolio site before bumping.
